audit_items.proof_trace: Flash loan fee is computed at borrow time as `flash_loan_fee_rate.int_mul(amount)` from emode config (oracle-independent) and is immutably embedded in the `FlashLoan` hot-potato; repayment enforces `coin.value() == amount + fee` with no oracle lookup. The only public oracle-update path (`user_oracle::refresh_usd_price`) requires a valid Pyth `PriceInfoObject` whose identity is verified via `assert_pyth_price_info_object`—users cannot inject arbitrary prices. Borrow safety further uses `get_price_with_check` (EMA with EMA/spot tolerance), making borrow-path extraction via a transient price spike infeasible.
